name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + graphics domain (matches System=graphics) + descriptor text_scroll_pending_line_count reflecting a pending row-count counter for the dual-mode cylinder scroll. No Ghidra address residue in the tail (count is a semantic word). Data-type role (a mutable byte counter) is conveyed.
purpose: Pending line-count state byte that parameterizes fd2_scroll_text_screen_up_by_lines: Mode A stores the desired row count here; the next Mode B (param==0) call reads it as N and cylinder-scrolls the 0xC0-row background buffer up by N lines.
logic_summary: Single 1-byte unsigned state. Mode A (param != 0): MOV [0x51A10],AL stores low byte of param then returns. Mode B (param == 0): MOVZX byte ptr [0x51A10] read back as N drives malloc(N*0x138), save bottom N rows, shift remaining rows down by N (content moves up), paste saved rows at top (cylinder), free scratch. Initial static value 0x01.
element_semantics: Single element = N, the number of background rows the next Mode-B scroll-up will shift (and the count of rows wrapped from bottom to top). 1 row = 0x138 bytes; buffer is 0xC0 rows.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (dialog.c lines 1247-1255) was already accurate and concise; no issue.
